data.description: Logan 是美团点评集团推出的大前端日志系统。名称是 Log 和 An 的组合，代表个体日志服务，同时也是金刚狼大叔的大名。

data.description: Logan is a large-scale front-end logging system launched by Meituan Dianping Group. The name is a combination of Log and An, representing individual log services, and also the big name of Wolverine.
data.label: Logan
